**Verdict:** No defensible overall ranking: the indicators are on one scale only as pushes on this index, but they differ in geography (national, regional, provincial), in weight basis (evidence vs default) and in missingness, and none except climate news and the regional hunger outcome has independent support. Present them as contributing evidence, not ranked causes.
